description.zh: 帮你看懂体检报告：把历年指标整理成对比表，标出超出参考范围、连续异常和越来越偏离的项目，用通俗的话解释指标含义，告诉你哪些需要复查、可以挂什么科、生活上能做什么。不做诊断，不能代替医生。
description.en: Makes sense of checkup reports: organizes results year over year, flags out-of-range, persistent and worsening items, explains each in plain words, and suggests follow-ups, departments and lifestyle steps. Not a diagnosis or a substitute for a doctor.

welcome_message.zh: 把体检报告上的指标发给我，我帮你整理和解读
welcome_message.en: Send me your checkup results and I'll organize and explain them

prompt.zh: 这是我今年的体检结果 ___，帮我看看哪些需要注意。
prompt.en: Here are this year's results ___. What should I pay attention to?

prompt.zh: 这是我 ___ 年到 ___ 年的体检数据，帮我做个对比表看趋势。
prompt.en: Here are my results from ___ to ___. Build a comparison and show trends.

prompt.zh: ___ 偏高 / 偏低是什么意思？要紧吗？
prompt.en: What does a high/low ___ mean? Is it serious?

prompt.zh: 我的 ___ 异常，应该挂什么科？多久复查？
prompt.en: My ___ is abnormal. Which department and when to recheck?

prompt.zh: 血脂和尿酸偏高，日常饮食和运动要怎么调整？
prompt.en: My lipids and uric acid are high. How should I adjust diet and exercise?

prompt.zh: 下周去看 ___ 科，我该带什么、问医生哪些问题？
prompt.en: I'm seeing ___ next week. What should I bring and ask?

zh: 每年体检后第 3 天「20:00」提醒录入本年体检数据并生成对比表
异常指标复查前 7 天「10:00」提醒预约复查
每月 1 日「09:00」提醒记录体重和家庭血压
每季度第一天「10:00」回顾需要持续关注的指标和生活方式执行情况
就诊前一天「20:00」整理历年报告和想问医生的问题
每年 11 月 1 日「10:00」提醒预约明年的年度体检
en: 3 days after each annual checkup at 20:00, remind to enter results and build the comparison
7 days before a recheck at 10:00, remind to book it
On the 1st of each month at 09:00, remind to log weight and home blood pressure
On the first day of each quarter at 10:00, review markers to watch and lifestyle progress
The day before a doctor's visit at 20:00, gather past reports and questions
On November 1 at 10:00, remind to book next year's checkup
